mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a beautiful 73 degrees with clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park, and the moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

For our community news, remember that VHAT serves as our local cable channel for government meetings and information. Additionally, the city has updated regulations regarding vehicle storage, requiring that any recreational vehicles be parked on an approved surface and set back at least five feet from property lines.

There is a great lineup of local activities. We have the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market happening today, and you can also enjoy Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory today. Tomorrow, be sure to check out Concerts in the Park or the weekly Hop Haus Trivia.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 15, officers responded to a residence on Prairie Oaks Drive where a local man was arrested for felony bail jumping.
You can cool down with today's flavor, Mint Explosion, at Culver's. They are open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
